jobs.occupation: Commercial Solutions Engineer - Asset & Wealth Management
jobs.description:
As a Solutions Engineer, you will play a central role in helping Performativ win and onboard strategic clients across the asset and wealth management industry. You will partner closely with sales to uncover client needs, design tailored solutions, and demonstrate how our platform drives measurable business value. From first discovery to successful onboarding, you will help clients accelerate time to value through strong industry expertise and a highly consultative approach.

What you’ll do 📈

• 
Partner with sales on high-value opportunities to understand client goals, challenges, and priorities across asset and wealth management.

• 
Lead discovery sessions to uncover business pain points related to portfolio analytics, performance measurement, regulatory reporting, and data quality.

• 
Design and deliver compelling presentations, product demos, and proof-of-concepts tailored to client use cases and decision criteria.

• 
Act as a trusted advisor during the sales cycle by bringing relevant market knowledge and industry insight to senior stakeholders.

• 
Translate complex client requirements into solution designs that demonstrate clear ROI and business impact.

• 
Support new clients during onboarding by helping configure dashboards, reporting structures, analytics, and workflows aligned with their objectives.

• 
Work closely with product, engineering, and client success teams to ensure a smooth transition from pre-sales to implementation.

• 
Build strong relationships with customers post-sale to support adoption and identify expansion opportunities.

What we’re looking for 🎯

• 
5-7 years of experience in asset and wealth management, ideally in a solutions engineering, pre-sales, or client-facing product role.

• 
Deep expertise in financial and portfolio reporting, including performance measurement, risk metrics, and regulatory disclosures.

• 
Strong commercial mindset with a proven ability to influence buying decisions and contribute to revenue growth.

• 
Excellent presentation, communication, and storytelling skills, especially when engaging C-level stakeholders.

• 
Ability to simplify complex technical and financial concepts into clear, value-driven client conversations.

• 
Experience working with SaaS platforms and API-driven solutions in financial services.

• 
Consultative approach with the ability to uncover needs, shape solutions, and build trust with clients.

• 
Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with cross-functional collaboration.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Trust and responsibility to shape the future of Performativ’s success in the European market from day 1.

• 
Join a fast-growing fintech scaleup supported by top-tier VCs.

• 
Work with intelligent, passionate, and driven professionals with experience from leading institutions (such as Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon etc).

• 
Accelerate your career with opportunities for professional development and leadership.

Join a Team of Fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is making waves in the wealth management ecosystem and is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions do business around the world. Working at Performativ means working at a fast-paced tech scaleup with intelligent people who are passionate about their work. We are on a scaling journey beyond all metrics and expectations - and can't wait to have you join us in making a real impact.

We are funded by some of the leading VC funds in the world and expectations are set to be established as a European market leader in a record amount of time.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com

We value passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We are passionate with ambitious goals and value the time and effort people put into their work. You will be part of the family from day one, and responsible for making your mark and driving forward your vision. Autonomous work is embedded in our culture, and we are committed to ensure you have all the tools and support you need while acknowledging the importance of flexibility.

jobs.occupation: Senior AI Engineer for The Tech Collective
jobs.description:
We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

**What You'll Do

**This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

**In This Role, You'll

**

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

**What You'll Bring

**We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

**Beyond That, You'll Bring

**

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

**What We Offer

**You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Tech Collective

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant or outsourcing company.

Deliver with focus. Scale with intent 🚀

Are you a delivery leader who knows how to guide enterprise customers through complex set-ups without over-engineering the journey? Do you care deeply about building scalable, repeatable SaaS delivery rather than one-off custom projects?

At Performativ, we’re building the infrastructure layer for modern wealth management. As our Engagement Manager, you’ll lead the enterprise rollout of our SaaS platform helping customers onboard successfully through structured delivery, clear communication, and lightweight technical engagement.

This is not a professional services consulting role. You won’t be buried in endless customer-specific code or heavy customizations. Instead, you’ll work cross-functionally to help customers adopt our product the right way: cleanly, securely, and in line with platform best practices so they can scale on top of us, not around us.

What you will do

• 
Own enterprise set-up programs end to end (kick-off through go-live and hyper-care) against an agreed plan and scope (Statement of Work).

• 
Enable customers to integrate Performativ via standard platform patterns (APIs, SSO, configuration) without custom buildouts, working with product and engineering to flag gaps early and advocate for scalable paths.

• 
Own plan, scope, and change control, keeping scope tied to contract and change visible and decided rather than quietly absorbed, and support the Technical Program Lead on requirements, design documents, and acceptance-criteria sign-off.

• 
Run customer communication, cadence, and governance with reporting that keeps meetings short, and manage risk, dependency, and issue tracking (including customer-side).

• 
Lead a clean handover to Customer Success at go-live or hyper-care exit, including train-the-trainer sessions and supporting materials.

• 
Represent the program in internal capacity and exception reviews, bringing requests the plan cannot absorb back as options rather than committing on the spot.

• 
Build repeatable playbooks, documentation, and artefacts that make the next program faster. You will be measured on this, not only on your own delivery.

How you will work

You will run multiple programs at once, in a delivery pod alongside the Technical Program Lead, Integration Engineers, Data Migration Specialists, and Product Engineers. None report to you. Rather you get things done through clarity and relationships, not authority. You will report to the COO. This is an in-office role based at our Copenhagen office.

What we're looking for

• 
7+ years in program or engagement management, consulting, product management, or another delivery-facing role, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end to end.

• 
Comfort being firm with customers on scope and timeline while keeping the relationship stronger for it.

• 
Any industry background welcome. Experience with enterprise customers (banks, asset managers, regulated industries), balancing urgency against long-term maintainability highly advantageous.

• 
Structured and highly organized, producing written plans, governance cadences, and reporting that stakeholders can act on.

• 
Broad technical literacy across enterprise SaaS delivery: API-based integrations, SSO and security configuration, and data migration and mapping, including enough SQL to read and question a mapping. You do not build the integration, but you understand it well enough to scope it, question it, and know when something does not add up.

• 
Ability to build working fluency in the customer's business domain fast: within 90 days, able to discuss topics such as advice and suitability workflows and customer reporting without a subject-matter expert in the room.

• 
ITIL Foundation, PMP or PRINCE2 Certification would be beneficial.

Technical Fluency

• 
You’re not, necessarily, a developer, but you’re comfortable with APIs, data structures, auth flows (OAuth/SAML), and deployment models.

• 
You can dive into logs, payloads, and basic SQL or Python when needed to unblock yourself or a customer - but you prioritize scalable fixes over tactical workarounds.

• 
You advocate for platform-aligned solutions, not special cases.

What this role is not

This role sits in operations, not engineering or commercial, and is project-based: once delivery is complete, you roll on to the next engagement. As a SaaS provider, we do not build bespoke software; delivery works within the bounds of the product.

We can offer :

• 
Trust and responsibility to shape how Performativ delivers for its largest customers.

• 
A competitive salary and benefits package.

• 
A fast-growing, VC-backed fintech scaleup, working alongside professionals from leading institutions (Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon and others).

• 
Career acceleration through professional development and leadership opportunities.

Build the platform every engineering team depends on and shape how Performativ scales through reliability, resilience, and world-class developer experience.

As our Hands-On Lead Cloud Engineer, you will lead Mission Control, our Platform Engineering and Reliability team. Mission Control creates secure, self-service platform capabilities that enable product teams to build, deploy, and operate services independently. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you'll spend the majority of your time building production infrastructure and platform capabilities, leading through technical contribution rather than process.

What you’ll do 📈

• 
Lead Mission Control while remaining deeply hands-on across cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and reliability.

• 
Build and evolve the default, secure-by-default platform that enables product teams to build, deploy, and operate services independently.

• 
Create reusable AWS CDK constructs, infrastructure standards, and golden paths that reduce complexity and improve the developer experience across engineering.

• 
Set the technical direction for Mission Control, making pragmatic decisions about platform evolution, reliability, and developer experience while helping the team execute.

• 
Strengthen our reliability practices through SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident tooling, and post-incident improvements that drive meaningful change.

• 
Treat cloud cost as a first-class engineering concern by improving visibility, eliminating waste, and designing systems that scale efficiently.

• 
Partner closely with our security specialists to build secure-by-default platform capabilities and continuously strengthen our security posture.

• 
Own the evolution of the engineering platform that enables every product team to build, deploy, and operate services independently.

• 
Provide technical leadership, coaching, and feedback to a small team of experienced platform engineers while remaining deeply involved in delivery.

What we’re looking for 🎯

• 
7+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar production-focused environments.

• 
Experience leading or mentoring engineers while remaining hands-on and actively contributing to code and infrastructure.

• 
Strong experience designing and operating production workloads on AWS, including Infrastructure as Code. Experience with AWS CDK and TypeScript is strongly preferred.

• 
Strong understanding of the AWS Well-Architected Framework and practical application of its principles.

• 
A platform engineering mindset focused on building reusable capabilities, self-service, and engineering leverage.

• 
Strong operational judgment with experience in incident response, reliability engineering, SLOs, and continuous improvement.

• 
Comfort owning outcomes, making decisions in ambiguous environments, and improving engineering practices without adding unnecessary process.

• 
Actively leverages AI and agent-assisted engineering workflows to improve productivity while applying sound engineering judgment and maintaining high quality standards.

• 
Experience working within fintech or other regulated industries is a plus.

Technologies you'll work with 💻

You don't need experience with every technology listed below. We care far more about strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and your ability to learn, build, and improve systems.

• 
Infrastructure & Cloud: AWS CDK (TypeScript), Terraform (bonus), and modern AWS infrastructure, networking, security, governance, and observability services.

• 
Engineering Tooling: GitHub Actions, Docker, container pipelines, cloud cost optimization, and observability tooling.

• 
Wider Engineering Stack: You'll collaborate with teams building services primarily in Golang and TypeScript, alongside React, React Native, Python, and PHP.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Trust and responsibility to shape the future of Performativ’s success in the European market from day 1.

• 
Join a fast-growing fintech scaleup supported by top-tier VCs.

• 
Work with intelligent, passionate, and driven professionals with experience from leading institutions (such as Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon etc).

As a Senior Front-End Engineer, you will co-own the front-end experience for Performativ's trading and analytics platform, building high-performance interfaces used by wealth managers and financial institutions. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct ownership of architecture, implementation, and production outcomes.

About the team 👥

The engineering team owns the platform that powers portfolio management, trading, analytics, reporting, compliance, and client engagement at Performativ. Front-end engineers work closely with backend engineers, product, and design to turn complex financial workflows into software that advisors can use every day.

The team ships continuously and gives engineers ownership over implementation decisions. On the front end, the current focus is scaling a Next.js and React architecture across increasingly sophisticated workflows while keeping performance, server and client boundaries, theming, and shared components under control.

About the role 🎯

We are looking for a Senior Front-End Engineer to co-own the quality, performance, and architecture of our trading and analytics interfaces. This role is responsible for building production UIs, shaping front-end architecture, and raising the standard of our shared component infrastructure.

You will work closely with backend engineering, product, and design to ship financial workflows from requirements through production. You will co-own the end-to-end front-end scope, including server and client boundaries, hydration strategy, state management, performance, multi-tenant theming, testing, and the component library used across the platform.

This role requires deep React and TypeScript expertise, strong architectural judgment, and the ability to turn complex financial workflows into fast, usable interfaces. You need to be comfortable making implementation decisions independently and shipping production software without management overhead.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together from our city-center office, with working from home possible when there is a good reason. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What you'll do 📈

• 
Build high-performance trading, analytics, and portfolio management interfaces used by wealth management professionals.

• 
Co-own front-end architecture across Next.js 15, React Server Components, TypeScript, and our shared application infrastructure.

• 
Define server and client boundaries, hydration strategies, and state patterns that keep the platform responsive as complexity grows.

• 
Scale our shared component library and multi-tenant theming across the platform.

• 
Improve runtime performance, bundle size, rendering behavior, and application responsiveness.

• 
Ship production features quickly while making architectural decisions that hold up as the product scales.

• 
Use AI coding agents where they improve engineering throughput while maintaining control over code quality and implementation decisions.

• 
Strengthen front-end testing and delivery across Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, and CI/CD workflows.

• 
Co-own implementation decisions from product outcome through production deployment.

What we're looking for 🔍

• 
Have built sophisticated production web applications with React and TypeScript and can structure front-end codebases that continue to work as product complexity grows.

• 
Understand modern React architecture, including React Server Components and the Next.js App Router, or can demonstrate the technical depth to become productive with them quickly.

• 
Have shipped production work using AI coding agents and understand where they improve engineering output and where direct engineering judgment is required.

• 
Have improved front-end performance through decisions around bundle size, hydration, rendering, data fetching, and runtime behavior.

• 
Are comfortable managing server state with TanStack Query and can make deliberate decisions about colocated state and client state libraries.

• 
Have built or extended component systems using tools such as Radix, shadcn/ui, or custom design systems.

• 
Understand usability, accessibility, and interaction design well enough to make sound UX decisions without treating design as somebody else's problem.

• 
Have shipped tested production software using tools such as Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

Preferred experience ➕

• 
Have worked on trading, investment management, portfolio analytics, or other data-intensive financial applications.

• 
Have worked with AG Grid or comparable data-grid infrastructure for complex datasets and interactions.

• 
Have worked in a pnpm and Turborepo monorepo with generated API types from OpenAPI specifications.

• 
Have designed front-end systems supporting multiple tenants, brands, or configurable themes.

• 
Have mentored engineers or raised engineering standards without moving away from hands-on development.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Work that reaches production fast. We ship weekly. Your work will be used by advisors and financial institutions within days, not quarters.

• 
Colleagues who set a high bar. Our team comes from Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, and Amazon. Standards are high. Politics are absent.

• 
Career compression. People here take on scope in twelve months that takes five years elsewhere. If you can carry it, we will give it to you.

• 
Direct access to founders, customers, and the market. You will sit in the rooms where decisions get made.

• 
Backing from leading venture funds, and a mandate to become the European standard rather than a regional alternative.

About Performativ 🚀

Wealth management runs on software built for a different era. Batch files. Overnight reconciliation. Client reports assembled by hand. Advisors spend more time fighting their systems than advising clients. The industry has accepted this for thirty years.

We are replacing that layer. Performativ is one platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, and client engagement, built from the ground up for how wealth is actually managed today. Banks, family offices, and independent advisors across Europe run on it.

We are a scaleup, not a startup. The product is live, the customers are real, and the growth is ahead of plan. We intend to be the system European wealth management runs on. That is not positioning. It is the plan we are executing against.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com

The bar 🔥

We are builders. We move fast, we say what we think, and we do not manage each other. Autonomy is the default, which only works if you are the kind of person who does not need to be told twice.

This is not a role for someone looking to coast inside a growing company. It is a role for someone who wants scope, wants pressure, and wants to point at something in two years and say they built it. If that is you, apply. If it is not, this will be uncomfortable, and we would rather say so now.

We operate globally across multiple ecosystems, delivering everything from large-scale arena events and broadcasts to digital products and content.

Our values — Make it Bold, Make it Together and Make it Happen — shape how we work, collaborate and deliver.

Welcome to the Global Mobility Team at BLAST!

At BLAST, we bring people together – across borders, stages, and time zones. Now we’re  looking for a Global Mobility Consultant to join our team and help us ensure  that our people can thrive wherever in the world our events take them.

You’ll be part of a small but passionate team of colleagues, working closely with People and Culture, Travel,  Finance, Legal, and Live Events to build and run a world-class mobility framework that supports BLAST’s global growth.

Who You Are – To Succeed in This Role

You're an excellent communicator, a proactive problem-solver, and a trusted partner to  your colleagues. You thrive in a dynamic environment, love the details, and care about  creating smooth experiences for people on the move.

Requirements

Experience:

• A degree in HR, Business Administration, Legal – or equivalent experience

• 3+ years of experience with international assignments and cross-border employment particularly in relation to North America and Asia

• Strong understanding of mobility processes and compliance

• Solid experience working with Excel (e.g. data management, formulas, reporting) Proficiency in tools like Smartsheet, Google Sheets, and AI and automation tools and platforms

• Experience providing team leadership, guidance, and mentorship within a small team environment

• Previous background in the sports, entertainment, or fast-paced live events industry, given the scale of international tournaments.

• Demonstrated flexibility, interpretation, and creativity in navigating complex or ambiguous visa regulations across global destinations lacking standardized visa categories.

• Experience with budget tracking, cost control, PO creation, and managing financial considerations related to global mobility and travel.

• Proven ability to manage high-pressure situations, tight event deadlines, and complex logistical escalations independently.

• Strong cross functional  stakeholder engagement skills to coordinate seamlessly across all the internal Blast teams as well as external vendors.

• Willingness to work flexible hours during major events or travel occasionally between the London and Copenhagen offices.

Benefits

What We Offer – Life at BLAST

• At BLAST, you’ll join a creative, collaborative, and international environment where no two  days are the same. We’re proud of our culture – one where people are seen, heard, and  encouraged to bring ideas forward.

Here’s a glimpse of what you’ll get:

• A fast-paced and supportive workplace

• Great colleagues

• Flexible working conditions

• Centrally located office in Copenhagen

• Personal and professional development opportunities

• Friday bars, social events, and access to world-class esports action

Ready to join us?

We’re excited to meet you. Apply now and help us shape the future of Global Mobility at  BLAST

About BLAST

At BLAST, we’re all about creating extraordinary live and digital experiences — from arena-packing esports tournaments to unforgettable content that engages fans around the globe. We Make It Bold by challenging the norm and delivering fresh, creative formats that redefine what’s possible in the industry. We Make It Together by building close, collaborative partnerships with world-leading game publishers and brands to produce truly world-class results. And we Make It Happen by bringing energy, precision, and a problem-solving mindset to everything we do — across games like Counter-Strike, DOTA 2, Rainbow Six Siege, Rocket League, and Fortnite.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and share our passion for pushing boundaries, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Resourcer at BLAST, you will handle day-to-day resourcing for our global tournaments and live entertainment productions through our platform for freelancer management. Working as part of our resourcing team, you will support operational talent booking and help deploy freelance talent needed to run our studio and arena shows worldwide.

This is a fast-paced, collaborative role for someone who excels at logistics and scheduling, works comfortably with day rates, and enjoys building great relationships with talent.

Key Responsibilities

Freelance Booking & Scheduling

• Coordinate freelance bookings to ensure projects are staffed with the right talent.

• Confirm freelancer availability, negotiate rates within approved budgets, and manage bookings through Worksome.

• Maintain resource schedules and quickly resolve any booking conflicts or last-minute changes.

Talent Sourcing & Onboarding

• Build and maintain a strong network of freelance talent across key markets.

**Job Title: Global Service Specialist – DO/EIMCO, Flotation, PCV, DSG

**Position Summary

**FLS is seeking a highly skilled and professional Global Service Specialist to support the erection, installation, pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and operational startup of commercial and industrial separation equipment. This role focuses primarily on mechanical work and Installation & Commissioning (I&C) activities for thickeners and flotation cells, with additional responsibility for equipment such as clarifiers, cyclones, pumps, reactors, and agitated tanks.

The Global Service Specialist serves as FLS’s primary onsite representative and is responsible for delivering high‑quality technical service, maintaining strong customer relationships, and ensuring safe and efficient project execution. This position requires extensive international travel and the ability to work independently under demanding conditions.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Execute onsite erection, installation, alignment, and commissioning of mechanical systems and I&C activities for thickeners, flotation cells, and related separation equipment.

• Lead pre‑commissioning and commissioning processes to ensure equipment meets design, safety, and performance requirements.

• Support operational startup, troubleshooting, and optimization of equipment performance.

• Conduct inspections, testing, calibration, and verification of mechanical and control‑related systems.

• Coordinate onsite project activities, schedules, and resources to ensure timely completion.

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and project management teams to resolve technical issues.

• Prepare accurate and professional documentation, including installation records, commissioning reports, and service summaries.

• Maintain compliance with all safety, quality, and regulatory standards.

• Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for customers, providing training, guidance, and technical support.

• Represent FLS with professionalism and integrity in all customer interactions.

**Qualifications

****Required

**

• Strong mechanical background with hands‑on experience in Installation & Commissioning (I&C) of industrial process equipment.

• Experience with thickeners, flotation cells, clarifiers, cyclones, pumps, reactors, or similar industrial equipment.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently and make informed decisions under pressure.

• Strong project management skills, including planning, coordination, and documentation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce high‑quality technical reports.

• Ability and willingness to travel internationally up to 70% of the time.

• Professional demeanor with the ability to represent the company effectively onsite.

**Preferred

**

• Experience in commissioning or startup of industrial process systems.

• Background in mining, minerals processing, water treatment, or heavy industrial environments.

• Multilingual capabilities or experience working in multicultural settings.

• Ability to meet all medical and physical fitness requirements necessary to obtain work authorization for high‑altitude job sites.

**Competencies

**

• Technical proficiency in mechanical systems and industrial equipment

• Strong problem‑solving and decision‑making abilities

• Customer service orientation

• Professional communication and reporting skills

• Ability to perform effectively in high‑pressure environments

• Self‑motivation and independence in field operations

We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.

_Are you motivated by becoming the technical expert behind products and solutions that support clean water and energy? Do you thrive in a role where you connect technical development, business needs, and customer requirements? Are you excited by the opportunity to influence products throughout their entire lifecycle while collaborating with stakeholders across the organization?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**In the role as our next Technical Product Specialist within our software applications, your job will be to provide technical expertise across the product lifecycle while ensuring that products, solutions, and technical documentation remain accurate, compliant, and competitive.

More specifically you will be:

• Acting as the technical liaison between Research and Development, Sales, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders

• Providing technical support including tender support, sales support, product training, and advanced troubleshooting

• Serving as the technical expert on products, configurations, software solutions, and applications

• Maintaining technical product information and documentation

• Supporting product lifecycle activities including new product development, maintenance, and phase in and phase out activities

You will experience the freedom to act and leave your mark on how we manage and support our products throughout their lifecycle. Therefore, you will work closely with technical and commercial stakeholders across the organization, gain deep insight into our products and technologies, and play a key role in ensuring knowledge sharing, product adoption, and continuous improvement.

**Meet your future team

**With direct reference to Senior Manager, Technical Product Management, you will become part of the technical product management team. As a team, we are committed to ensuring our products remain technically accurate, competitive, and capable of meeting both market and business requirements, and you will have a key role in achieving this. In the team you will experience close collaboration with colleagues across product management, development, customer service, sales, and supply chain. Together we support products throughout their lifecycle while ensuring strong stakeholder engagement and knowledge sharing across the organization.

Did you know? As a Technical Product Specialist, you will work with stakeholders from many different functions, making every day an opportunity to learn something new about our products, technologies, and customers.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for a Technical Product Specialist who is ready to take ownership of technical product activities and who is motivated by solving complex challenges. You achieve this through strong collaboration skills, technical curiosity, and a structured approach to your work.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Engineering within Electronics, Software, Mechatronics, or a similar field.

• Have an understanding of product development, product lifecycle management, and technical product support

• Have experience with, or an understanding of, software-related systems such as Swagger documentation, Jira, Confluence or comparable platforms. A general end-to-end understanding of hardware and connectivity along with insights to APIsis an advantage.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with the ability to communicate technical information clearly

• Have experience with product related systems such as Configure Price Quote, Product Lifecycle Management, Enterprise Resource Planning, or similar platforms.

We also value experience developing and delivering technical training and knowledge sharing activities

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than the ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, cycle team, during our yearly summer festival or on the padel court. For example, is our Head of System Engineering and Information Technology Denmark also our volunteer padel instructor while our Software Test Engineer runs weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Manager, Technical Product Management, Kirsten Sahl, by phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

**Get to know us

**At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible all with the purpose of securing clean water and energy to the maximum number of people. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us. Explore more on our website, see our annual report, and stay updated through LinkedIn for the latest news and job openings.

Join us in this role where you’ll take a leading role in monitoring, triaging, and resolving OT and SCADA incidents across global wind assets. You’ll coordinate incident response across disciplines, drive root cause analysis, and strengthen operational resilience to ensure safe, secure, and reliable energy production. As part of our 24/7 operational setup, you’ll also join an on-duty rotation for one week each month, giving you the opportunity to take ownership when it matters most and help keep our assets running safely and reliably around the clock.

**Welcome to OT Guard & Service Management

**You’ll be part of OT Guard & Service Management where you, together with your colleagues, will support offshore and onshore assets by ensuring stable, secure, and compliant OT and SCADA operations across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with control rooms, cybersecurity, engineering teams, and suppliers to manage incidents and maintain high operational standards.

As a team, we we collaborate closely, act with integrity, and share knowledge openly to deliver safe, resilient, and high‑performing operations, even in high‑pressure situations.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• monitoring OT system health, security events, and operational alerts across wind assets, substations, and onshore facilities

• triaging and responding to OT and SCADA incidents in close coordination with control room, cybersecurity, and engineering teams

• performing root cause analysis and documenting preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents

• conducting remote diagnostics and coordinating field or supplier interventions when required

• maintaining accurate incident records, handovers, and runbooks to support 24/7 operations

• contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen system resilience, supplier performance, and operational standards.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have experience working with OT or SCADA systems in critical infrastructure environments, or equivalent experience

• understand industrial control system architectures and protocols, such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, Modbus/TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, or equivalent experience

• are confident troubleshooting networks, operating systems, and system integrations in complex OT landscapes

• communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines, regions, and suppliers

• remain structured and calm when handling incidents in changing operational conditions

• hold a degree in engineering, automation, computer science, cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr81,720.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

**Job Description

**Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments, working with some of the most complex and modern data solutions on the market? Are you ready to take ownership of shaping data architecture? If so, you might be our next colleague.

In Data Management, you join a team that enables our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

As a Senior Data Architect, you will work in the intersection of technology and business. Data is at the core of everything we do, and our analyses, advice, and solutions consistently create real value for our customers. Your work involve developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, distribute, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, Spark, Kafka, Dagster, Airflow, Terraform and others.

**Responsibilites

**

• Designing, modeling, and building data solutions such as data platforms, data warehouse architecture, and business intelligence applications.

• Taking co-ownership of data architecture, defining technical direction, and driving customer advisory, data strategy, and business analysis in collaboration with the project team and customer.

• Leading and mentoring team members, prioritizing and organizing work, and providing technical guidance and direction.

• Quickly getting up to speed on existing solutions and taking ownership of them, while defining the right path forward for new projects based on best practices.

• Performing technical quality assurance and reviews on data models, ETL processes, and solution architecture across projects.

**About You

**You hold a relevant degree in data science, software engineering, computer science, mathematical modelling, or a similar field, along with solid professional experience in data management. Through your professional experience, you have gained deep technical expertise and a structured, logical approach to solving complex data challenges. As a Senior Data Architect, you are comfortable stepping into a leadership role guiding both people and the technical direction, and you thrive in a collaborative, development-oriented environment with a focus on continuous learning.

To succeed in this role, you have significant experience with:

• Designing and implementing data solutions, including data modelling, ETL/ELT, and data warehousing.

• Multiple languages and technologies such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R, as well as Fabric, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, Databricks, Dagster, Terraform and others.

• Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

• Supporting customers and colleagues through professional expertise and guidance.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

**Continue developing with us

**At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Role

**In this role, you will own and develop our Reward and benefits processes across the company. The scope includes our annual pay review, market benchmarking, benefits and incentive schemes, job architecture, and Rewards activities.

This role would suit a proactive Rewards professional who has previously perhaps worked in a team and is looking for their first stand alone. The expectations on you are to further develop and optimise our recently implemented rewards solutions, in particular in Workday, and support all of the company's rewards processes.

Our company is evolving fast and so an enjoyment of a dynamic and demanding environment with a delivery focus is essential for success.

**What You Will Do

**

• Developing Rewards in Workday to operate efficiently.

• Carrying out benchmarking and updating of pay against the job architecture

• Lead the annual pay-review process across the business.

• Maintaining up to date job architecture with regular reviews to ensure embedded in the organisation

• Develop and maintain our benefit and incentive programmes.

• Compiling required reports and data for pay budgeting, reviewing and equal pay requirements globally

• Continues to ensure that pay and benefits attract the highest calibre of talent available in our markets

**Essential

****What you bring

**

• Three to four years of hands-on experience in reward, compensation, benefits, or a closely related field that includes pay reviews, market benchmarking, benefits, incentive schemes, and job architecture.

• Experience managing reward or benefit activities across different countries, including cross-border pay equity and benefit plans.

• Hands-on experience using Mercer / Mercer Win benchmarking data and tools to compare jobs and pay across different markets.

25 days of paid vacation, plus five additional days once you have been with us for nine months

Access to thousands of courses through LinkedIn Learning

Wellbeing initiatives and an annual flu vaccination

Freshly prepared meals from our subsidised on-site canteen

Social activities through our Employee Association
